title: Electrical Work Order Checklist
subtitle: Residential Electrical Work: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Electrical Work Order Checklist covers branch circuit, panel position, device, conductor, load, and affected area. The electrical service coordinator records Residential Electrical Work criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Electrical Work Order Checklist keeps Residential Electrical Work exceptions visible until the electrical service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Electrical Work Order Checklist at residence, panel, circuit, room, device, and equipment connection. Document branch circuit, panel position, device, conductor, load, and affected area identity before Residential Electrical Work begins. Compare branch circuit, panel position, device, conductor, load, and affected area findings with stated Residential Electrical Work criteria; route unresolved Residential Electrical Work issues to qualified electrical reviewer. For Electrical Work Order Checklist, confirm requirements for Residential Electrical Work. Ask qualified electrical reviewer to review Residential Electrical Work conditions beyond the electrical service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Residential Electrical Work, identify responsible parties, residence, panel, circuit, room, device, and equipment connection, and the linked branch circuit, panel position, device, conductor, load, and affected area source.

fields.label: Panel, circuit, device, and load identifier
Reported trip, outage, heat, damage, or performance history

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Electrical Work facts for branch circuit, panel position, device, conductor, load, and affected area; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Electrical Work inspection checks
items: De-energization and absence-of-voltage control within scope
Panel, breaker, conductor, termination, and enclosure condition
Device, receptacle, switch, fixture, and grounding observation
Load, rating, labeling, and overcurrent-protection match
Heat, odor, arcing, moisture, and physical-damage signs

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Before closing Residential Electrical Work, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Electrical Service Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Service or panel condition outside authorization
Heat, arcing, damaged conductor, or moisture concern
Required permit or qualified authority unavailable
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Electrical Work when energization, grounding, overcurrent, conductor, panel, or authorization concern remains. Retain the available Residential Electrical Work proof and route unresolved branch circuit, panel position, device, conductor, load, and affected area scope to electrical service coordinator.
